 Judge reinstates Maurene Comey after ruling her firing unlawful 
 Judge Jesse Furman said Comey’s termination violated civil service rules. 
 1:21 Daughter of former FBI Director James Comey, Maurene Comey, leaves the Albert V. Bryan United States Courthouse, November 13, 2025 in Alexandria, Virginia. Alex Wong/Getty Images By Aaron Katersky October 26, 2026, 11:45 AM Share A federal judge in New York on Monday ruled against President Donald Trump and the Justice Department over the firing of Maurene Comey , daughter of former FBI Director James Comey, from the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Southern District of New York.  
 Judge Jesse Furman said Comey’s termination violated civil service rules.
